messages:
Sam (AE): Kicking off POC with Acme Health — need to lock success criteria, SE coverage, and timeline. Proposed 4-week runway starting Mon Apr 18. Customer flagged HIPAA-ish controls. Quick sync? :wave:

Priya (SE): I can cover weeks 1-2 for integration and prompt tuning, then Jordan can handle perf days in week 3. I'm OOO Apr 25-26.

Leslie (Customer): Confirming budget: trial is free but we need to know expected usage so we can estimate costs after POC. Also need answers on data handling and an SSA.

Sam (AE): Budget note — they're targeting ~200k tokens/day during peak. Pricing Q: is that hosted API or Dedicated recommendation for predictability?

Jordan (Eng): For consistent latency at that volume, Dedicated pool recommended. Hosted can work with routing + burst but cost variance higher. Can we get QPS distribution (peak vs baseline)?

Priya (SE): Success criteria proposal:
1) Functional: >=95% intent accuracy on eval set v1
2) Perf: p95 latency < 350ms (p99 goal < 500ms)
3) Ops: automatic fallback to smaller model on capacity failures
4) Security: pass customer baseline questionnaire
Agree or adjust?

Taylor (Security): I'll own the security questionnaire. Need to know whether logs with PHI will be sent to Redwood logs or routed to their VPC, and whether they prefer KMS/HSM.

Leslie (Customer): We require no persistent logs of PHI; prefer Private deployment or client-side redaction. Is token redaction during ingestion feasible?

Sam (AE): Action items: Priya draft eval prompt set by Apr 12; Jordan to scope Dedicated sizing by Apr 14; Taylor to start security Q by Apr 10. Proposed SE support: 8 hours/week baseline + on-call for perf days. Ack?

Priya (SE): Ack. I'll put together the eval harness and sample prompt pack. Quickstart repo: https://github.com/redwood/poc-template. Example eval run:
```bash
pytest tests/evals/test_prompts.py::test_intents -k smoke
```

Jordan (Eng): On Dedicated sizing — rough first pass: given 200k tokens/day with burst windows, I'll model GPU-hours and expected throughput and share numbers by Apr 14. I'll include latency simulations and fallback/replica plan.

Sam (AE): Customer asked about SLA for the POC window. We can offer 99% availability for Dedicated during the trial; I'll add this to the POC charter.

Taylor (Security): Leslie — who is the primary reviewer on the customer side? Need an email and preferred format (doc vs spreadsheet).

Leslie (Customer): Security reviewer is Mark Reed (mark.reed@acmehealth.com). He prefers a spreadsheet + short narrative.

redwood-bot: POC workspace created: https://console.redwood.com/poc/ACME-2026-04 — added Sam, Priya, Jordan.

Sam (AE): Great — I'll update the POC charter and delivery calendar by EOD. Meeting to finalize: Tue Apr 9 10am PT — calendar invite incoming. :calendar:
